denominator: games with recorded player appearance; no absolute snap floor

definitions.DE: Listed defensive ends within the original DL pool
definitions.ILB: Inside and other off-ball linebackers within the original LB pool
definitions.EDGE: Explicit EDGE players and outside rush linebackers within the original LB pool
definitions.S: Safeties, including free and strong safety

classificationPolicy: Exactly one group per defender. Preserve original DL/LB/DB parent. Prefer precise official roster labels; use ESPN roster/depth roles for broad labels. DE and EDGE are separate listed-role buckets, not disjoint football skills. Conflicting or missing roles remain for review.
notes: All 583 previously verified 25%-share qualifiers were assigned exactly one group. Original broad group totals are preserved: IDL+DE=192, ILB+EDGE=165, CB+S=226.
Snap-source unmatched players from the original research remain unresolved for eligibility even when their position role can be identified. They are not newly counted.
Counts are provisional research pools, not deployed site behavior.

ESPN roster and depth-chart roles supplement specific official roster labels. DE and EDGE are separate listed-role buckets; both can rush the passer. This is not an assertion that defensive ends cannot be edge rushers.

Specific roster positions may differ from formation slots. For example Nnamdi Madubuike is rostered as DT by ESPN but listed at LDE in its base 3-4 depth chart; the specific DT roster designation places him in IDL.
